summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its initial public offering of 34.5M units at $10.00/unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, generating $345M gross proceeds. Concurrently, it completed a private placement of 8.5M warrants at $1.00/warrant to the sponsor and underwriters. Net proceeds of $345M were placed in a trust account. This is a routine IPO closing disclosure, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are involved. There is no risk-arb angle; the filing simply satisfies SEC listing requirements.
